name: slack_claimed_verbal_approval_pending
use_case: Report a leave request's approval status truthfully
branch: The employee claims verbal manager approval in Slack but the leave request remains pending in the HR system
tests: the agent checks request status in the HR system and clarifies that verbal manager approvals do not update or finalize the request status
instruction:

You want the desk to confirm the status in the HR system, and if told it is still pending, you insist that your manager already approved it verbally and ask if the desk can just finalize it.

- Dates: 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-13
